items.text: The Seahawks released another estimated practice report on Tuesday and it didn't feature a change in status for wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba or defensive tackle Leonard Williams.

items.title: Bears activate DE Shemar Turner from PUP
items.text: The Bears activated defensive lineman Shemar Turner off the reserve/physically unable to perform list, the team announced Tuesday.

items.title: Chiefs put WR Tyquan Thornton on IR, sign LB Cam Jones to active roster
items.text: The Chiefs did not replace Tyquan Thornton on the active roster with another wide receiver.

items.title: Giants sign LB Malik Harrison to active roster
items.text: The Giants elevated linebacker Malik Harrison from the practice squad three times in the first five weeks of the season and they made a more permanent move with him on Tuesday.

items.title: Jaguars put Anton Harrison on injured reserve
